llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads /home/user/Desktop/21_0.pptx and navigates to slide index 2 (slide 3), matching the instruction target.
Getter identifies the title shape by searching for the known title text 'Add an Agenda Page', which matches the trajectory evidence for slide 3.
Getter returns 'title_bold' from run.font.bold, which is the correct python-pptx API for checking bold formatting on text runs.
Postconfig saves the file via Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring the getter reads the latest state.
Metric correctly checks title_bold is True and returns 1.0/0.0, semantically matching the instruction requirement.
Expected value 'expected_bold: true' is semantically correct for a 'bold the title' task; initial state is False so no false positive on unchanged file.

Minor: Getter only inspects the first run of the first non-empty paragraph. If the title spans multiple runs with mixed bold states, this may miss non-bold runs. However, for a typical Ctrl+B selection, all runs are set bold together.
Minor: Metric does not consume the 'expected' parameter (hardcoded True comparison). This is equivalent for this task since expected_bold is always true, but reduces generality.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Getter improvement: iterate all runs in the title paragraph and check that ALL runs have font.bold == True, rather than returning on the first run found.
Getter improvement: also check paragraph-level bold (para.font.bold) as a fallback when run.font.bold is None (inherited), to handle LibreOffice paragraph-level bold formatting.
